citation.authors: Dong H, Shardow JY, Mulligan K, Oyibo P et al

record.population: 12 trials, 8,023 non-White adults (Black African, South Asian, South Korean, Chinese)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of vitamin D supplementation and bone health
record.finding: Of 8 trials measuring bone density, one in South Asians found a benefit. A meta-analysis showed a higher bone-specific alkaline phosphatase marker (SMD 0.96, 95% CI 0.09-1.83), which lost significance after excluding one clinically distinct study. One fracture study (n=5,106) found no difference. The authors conclude evidence supporting supplementation for bone health in non-White adults remains limited.
record.note: Mixed non-White populations; the Black African subgroup is not separated in the abstract.
